rationale: Roberts is best positioned to deliver the conference’s preferred narrow, institutionally cautious holding: talk-therapy bans keyed to communicative aim are content/viewpoint based under Reed/R.A.V., with NIFLA and Casey not supplying a lower-scrutiny carveout. Expect separate writings from Thomas/Alito (more categorical First Amendment framing) and at least one dissent (likely Sotomayor, with possible Kagan/Jackson joins) emphasizing licensing authority and a limiting construction.
